description: The tag step's structured answer for one clip.

description.description: One or two sentences saying what the clip shows.

ranges.description: Time ranges with vocabulary tags, in seconds from the clip start.

start.description: Range start in seconds from the clip start, read from the tile stamps.

end.description: Range end in seconds from the clip start, read from the tile stamps.

folder.description: The vocabulary folder naming what kind of label this is.

value.description: The vocabulary value for this range.

confidence.description: Confidence in this range from 0 to 1.

problems.description: Visible problems such as a smudge or a blocked view, empty when none.

outline_hint.description: A short hint for matching this clip to the outline later, or null.
